title: The Watchman and the Sword
description: The word of the Lord came to Ezekiel: When the Lord brings a sword against a land, the people appoint a watchman who is to blow the trumpet and warn them. If anyone hears the sound of the trumpet but does not take warning, they must bear their own guilt when the sword takes them. But if the watchman sees the sword coming and does not blow the trumpet, so that the people are not warned, then the Lord will require the blood of the slain from the watchman's hand. Thus the Lord has appointed Ezekiel as a watchman for the house of Israel: When he hears a word from God's mouth, he is to warn the wicked concerning their way. If he remains silent, the Lord will require his blood; if he warns them, he has saved himself [ref:Esek 33:1-9|Ezekiel 33:1-9].
